title: The distinct words, in order
hints: A set keeps one copy of each element, in sorted order. Build one from the list.
`StringSet.of_list words` makes the set and `StringSet.elements` turns it back into a sorted list.
explain: The reference is `StringSet.elements (StringSet.of_list words)`. Building the set drops the duplicates, and `elements` returns what's left in increasing order, as `compare` on strings orders them (capital letters first).
